statement: For every nontrivial pure three-cusp involution, one explicit coboundary-and-third-cusp solution space parametrizes all conjugators to the standard inversion. The third-cusp equation itself forces full-profinite generation by D.32. For an involution in GT_0, every conjugator in the full pure group P already lies in GT_0, by the exact equality C_{ker(lambda:P)}(delta)=1 and the Harbater-Schneps centralizer description GT_0=C_P(S_3). Nonemptiness is equivalent to nonemptiness at every specified characteristic finite quotient. An executed A_5 quotient certifies that a two-generator endomorphism can induce automorphisms on every maximal pro-p quotient while having proper full image.
depends_on: A-HerfortZalesskii2008, Theorem 5 of inspected author version
manuscript_passages: Part D(b): actual full GT_0 torsion and conjugacy
notes: The centralizer argument proves the morphism between the two conjugator sets rather than adding unsupported symmetry assumptions. It gives an exact unconditional criterion, not a claimed solution of that criterion for arbitrary involutions. The A_5 witness concerns the generation test only and is not asserted to arise from a nonstandard involution. New source inspected at its original author's PDF and publisher metadata; original Harbater-Schneps PDF independently reread.
